name: CrossPlay
summary: Games, puzzles and flashcards for e-ink, on top of a full CrossPoint e-reader.
description: CrossPlay is a fork of CrossPoint that keeps the whole e-reader and adds the other things a screen that holds still is good at: 25 games you think about rather than react to, among them chess, go, solitaire, sudoku, wordle and yahtzee, and 11 apps, among them Anki flashcards that work offline, offline Wikipedia, weather, notes, RSS and the xkcd archive. Eleven of the games can also be played between two devices side by side, with nothing to set up. The same build runs on reTerminal Sticky and the Xteink X4 Pro.

compatibility.notes: A microSD card is required; without one the device stops at an SD card error screen. Version 1.16.1 has been installed on a reTerminal Sticky by the project maintainer, run, used with touch and the buttons, and restarted.

assets.previewAlt: The CrossPlay lockup: the bracket-corners mark beside the word CrossPlay, in black on off-white

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: After installing
notes.description: When the flasher says it is done, press the reset button with a pin: the small hole on the bottom, first on the left. The Sticky then starts CrossPlay.

notes.title: microSD card required
notes.description: Insert a microSD card before first boot. CrossPlay stores game saves, player identity, books and flashcard decks on the card, and the Sticky does not ship with one. Without a card the firmware stops at an SD card error screen.

notes.title: Reading is unchanged
notes.description: The CrossPoint e-reader is kept in full. CrossPlay adds apps and games alongside it rather than replacing it.

notes.title: Controls
notes.description: Touch throughout. The two side keys page the shelf and the reader, and the shared Confirm/Power key confirms on a click and sleeps on a hold. Back is a left-to-right swipe from the left edge.
